id: \bYou would think it was a Ground Gym based off of what we use.
en: \bYou would think it was a Ground Gym based off of what we use.
it: \bA giudicare da cosa usiamo, si direbbe una Palestra di tipo Terra.

id: \rRoxanne: Thank you again for your help earlier.
en: \rRoxanne: Thank you again for your help earlier.
it: \rPetra: Grazie ancora per l'aiuto di prima.

id: \rYou have already shown me what a strong Trainer you are, so let's get started.
en: \rYou have already shown me what a strong Trainer you are, so let's get started.
it: \rMi hai già dimostrato che Allenatore forte sei, quindi cominciamo.
\rPetra: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Pietra.

id: \rTM69 contains Rock Polish. It greatly raises the users speed.
en: \rTM69 contains Rock Polish. It greatly raises the users speed.
it: \rLa MT69 contiene Lucidatura. Aumenta molto la Velocità di chi la usa.

id: \rRoxanne: Stop by and visit the school anytime you can.
en: \rRoxanne: Stop by and visit the school anytime you can.
it: \rPetra: Passa a visitare la scuola ogni volta che puoi.

id: \bRoxanne uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
en: \bRoxanne uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
it: \bPetra usa Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Erba, Lotta, Terra e Acciaio.

id: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bNonostante tutte queste debolezze, sono forti contro Fuoco, Coleottero, Volante e Ghiaccio. Anche le mosse di tipo Normale e Veleno non fanno molti danni.

id: \bRoxanne is the best Gym Leader around.
en: \bRoxanne is the best Gym Leader around.
it: \bPetra è la Capopalestra migliore che ci sia.
